added_failures_note: the reviewed run is an evidence node whose write paths reach no test file and whose manifest declares no baseline_suite or after_suite (classification.json shows manifest.data.baseline_suite and after_suite both null), so there is no base or head suite log and no failure ids to derive; the run's own gates each reported EXIT=0 and the committed JSON's verification.checks are all true.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: A holder's declared unit differs from the unit its held DD path declares; but held_path is always "" (run.py:168 sets the path empty for every search reason and run.py:216 discards the lineage reason), so held_path_unit is always null and suspect_unit_binding can never be true.

paths_successor_does_not_hold is non-empty; but it is computed from rec["shared_paths"], which is empty for every admitted row (guard.log records recorded_paths: [] for all six), so the successor-side condition is vacuous.

the sourceless total after the apply is not before minus retired, i.e. a supersede failed to move the population; falsify.log:2 shows exactly this check reddening when before["sourceless_total"] is incremented by one.
the planted different-quantity pair is admitted by the 0.8/0.5 floors; negcontrol.log records refused: true with admitted_by_floors empty.

findings.text: blocking: `row = entry(row["name"])` at run.py:216 rebinds the loop variable to the sources dict, so run.py:218 add_hits(row, row.get("reason", "")) reads reason off a dict that has no such key and never adds a lineage holder or held path. Replicating that loop against the committed lineage record touches 30 names and records 0 holders where the record names 21 held pairs; three of the 11 names the JSON reports as no_holder (cumulative_ethylene_count_due_to_gas_injection, cumulative_inside_flux_surface_total_electron_density, ratio_of_charge_of_conductor_to_voltage_of_conductor) in fact have a lineage holder and a held path, so they were referred unjudged though the brief required that held lineage path to count as one more held hit.

blocking: every one of the 132 holder entries in the committed JSON carries held_path "", so the suspect-binding check at run.py:295-299 had no held-path unit to compare and could not fire; suspect_holder_count 0 and the manifest's claim that zero is a deterministic finding rather than an unchecked path (manifest.md:104-107) are therefore false, and Jev's state (run.py:357-365) carried held_dd_paths with path null, so the seat was never shown the held DD path the brief requires.
follow-on: RECORDED_RECORD is assigned at run.py:64 and never referenced, a dead constant carrying another node's fragment path.

follow-on: the read and judge gates write no final EXIT= line (read.log and judge.log hold a bare JSON payload), so two of the driver's gates do not record their exit status as the brief requires; the manifest caveats this at its lines 100-102.
